subject.title: [Bug]: Video Talk browser E2E intercepts provider WebSockets and stalls camera readiness

question: Should the Control UI test owner sponsor a narrow harness repair that limits global WebSocket interception to Gateway traffic and adds explicit provider passthrough coverage?
rationale: The issue is protected for maintainer handling and the requested test seam affects the shared browser harness rather than one isolated scenario; owner confirmation is needed before an automated repair lane changes that contract.

options.title: Confirm the narrow harness repair
options.body: Validate the reported provider-routing boundary and authorize a focused helper-plus-regression-test change that preserves the existing mocked-provider default.

options.title: Treat as host-specific fixture work
options.body: If the routing behavior is already correct, retain the mock boundary and isolate the Chromium media/bootstrap failure with host-specific evidence instead.

recommendation.title: Confirm the narrow harness repair
recommendation.body: Validate the reported provider-routing boundary and authorize a focused helper-plus-regression-test change that preserves the existing mocked-provider default.

likelyOwner.reason: The report and related suite inventory provide the only available concrete ownership signal for this E2E failure cluster.
